tasks.description: Implement shared pure calendar/date-draft helpers with meaningful unit cases: real-calendar validity, leap years, past/today/future acceptance, local-day comparison without UTC shifts, variable-length years without an arbitrary product window, and invalid draft versus intentional clearing. No browser DOM or HTTP pass is claimed by these unit tests.

Extend store validation, task DTO and prepared statements with nullable dueDate. Implement transactional additive v1-to-v2 migration, idempotent repeated startup, legacy row/order preservation and fail-closed unsupported versions. Add store unit tests for create/change/clear, completion retention, invalid PATCH preservation and database reopen using isolated temporary databases. Update existing unit DTO expectations for the approved additive field without deleting CRUD coverage.

Expose the approved additive date API behavior through the existing HTTP/store boundary and explicitly allowlist the shared calendar module. Retain Host/Origin, JSON/UTF-8/body-size/CSP controls and stable INVALID_DUE_DATE errors. Omitted PATCH preserves the date, null clears it and invalid representations do not mutate it. Dedicated new integration coverage belongs to separately approved QA automation.

Extend existing creation/editor/list UI with labelled optional date controls, explicit clearing, autosave/draft state, saved date text and local-calendar Overdue presentation. Preserve active/completed behavior, ordering, focus and responsive styling. Distinguish native invalid/incomplete date drafts from an intentional empty value. Keep saved changes on Cancel; serialize pending saves. Refresh date presentation at render/visibility/local-day changes without defining a new product time-of-day rule.

Maintain the active baseline regression harness and documentation for the approved feature: change only the obsolete no-date-control assertion in the existing browser suite while retaining every original CRUD/responsive assertion; preserve invalid-date negative tests. Document v2 migration/backup/old-binary incompatibility and current startup. Run approved unit/static checks through the orchestrator and present source-bound semantic conformance plus actual diff/results for later human code review. Do not modify frozen captures, historical reports, SDLC runtime or QA-owned qa/ automation.
